scenario.name: Shared core router failure
scenario.description: CORE-RTR-01 loses both power supplies, cutting the New York and Singapore paths that share it.

incident.title: New York and Singapore offices are both offline
incident.description: Two branches lost all corporate and internet connectivity at the same time; Bengaluru is unaffected.
symptoms: Core router not responding to monitoring

ground_truth.root_cause: CORE-RTR-01 shut down after both power entry modules failed; it is the shared WAN aggregation point for the New York and Singapore branches.
